artifact_io.reason: Financial Writing persists WritingState, creates and hashes publication Word artifacts, renders files, invalidates stale downstream outputs, records knowledge writeback receipts, and may use explicitly referenced external artifact/evidence stores.

operational_hygiene.reason: The owner has durable maintenance, repeated-failure reliability handling, incident/quality-regression evidence, cleanup rules and scoped change-freeze behavior.

evolution.reason: The owner records Writing DNA learning evidence and admits general editorial or personalized writing changes only after candidate distillation and evidence-gated evaluation/regression.

hook_bindings.durable_task_state_location: financial_writing_agent.store.SQLiteStateStore at FINANCIAL_WRITING_DB for authoritative WritingState; continuity/tasks/financial-writing-main is workspace recovery metadata, not per-article runtime state
hook_bindings.authoritative_business_evidence_classes: persisted WritingState research/gates/trace/learning/methodology-receipt evidence plus hash-bound publication Word artifacts, audit Word, render/mechanical evidence and explicit knowledge-writeback receipts
hook_bindings.canonical_artifact_or_file_stores: owner runtime FINANCIAL_WRITING_RUNS for generated Word/render outputs during the active runtime; durable external delivery/evidence stores only when explicitly referenced with stable provider identity
hook_bindings.cache_or_reference_only_stores: Notion, Google Drive, StockBase, ArticleBase, chat history and render/search caches are reference/cache surfaces by default and never override current GitHub rules or authoritative WritingState merely by presence
hook_bindings.stable_identity_strategy: task_id + ArtifactKind + sha256 for generated Word artifacts; provider stable id/canonical ref for explicitly promoted external evidence; Git repository path + blob/commit SHA for engineering mutations
hook_bindings.read_freshness_requirements: load the exact current WritingState before each material stage; re-read/hash the current artifact for mechanical/final file decisions; prior-chat summaries, cached paths or remembered external content do not satisfy a freshness-sensitive read
hook_bindings.mutation_conflict_strategy: owner state-machine/stage guards plus current-session single-writer routing for WritingState; GitHub engineering mutations use blob-SHA compare-and-swap. Concurrent or stale writer ambiguity must fail closed rather than be resolved by last-writer chat memory
hook_bindings.post_write_verification_method: generated Word artifacts are checked for existence and sha256 and then mechanically/render audited; material GitHub changes require main re-read; external writeback/upload requires a stable receipt ref before PASS
hook_bindings.upstream_to_downstream_invalidation_rule: financial_writing_agent.runtime_service invalidates downstream editorial/draft/QA/artifact mappings when research/editorial/title/draft/delivery inputs materially change; stale render and dependent QA must be rebuilt
hook_bindings.delete_and_retention_rules: retain accepted/publication/audit evidence needed for the active task; cleanup may remove or rebuild stale render/cache outputs and superseded active artifacts only after dependency checks; do not delete business evidence for cleanliness
hook_bindings.superseded_artifact_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md change protocol plus runtime downstream invalidation: superseded active outputs/caches are cleared or rebuilt while Git history/audit evidence remains the engineering record
hook_bindings.external_artifact_vault_if_any: No external store is implicitly authoritative. Google Drive/Notion or another provider may be used only as an explicit source/deliverable/evidence vault with stable provider refs and verified write/readback receipts.
hook_bindings.observability_or_incident_evidence_locat: evals/quality_regression.json plus persisted WritingState learning evidence
hook_bindings.reliability_or_change_freeze_guard: financial_writing_agent.quality_regression.evaluate_candidate_distillation plus evaluate_quality_promotion plus references/maintenance.md repeated-failure reliability boundary
hook_bindings.superseded_mechanism_cleanup_rule: references/maintenance.md change-protocol remove or repair conflicting/superseded mechanisms

overrides.evaluator_selection: owner-local blind pairwise quality evaluation with candidate-position swap; GENERAL_EDITORIAL_QUALITY may improve without user-positive labels, while PERSONALIZED_WRITING_DNA requires real user acceptance/edit or performance evidence
overrides.artifact_locations: WritingState is owner-runtime durable state; generated Word/render artifacts live in the configured owner runtime store until an explicitly verified external delivery/evidence ref is recorded

action_receipt_wiring.unwired_or_unproven_profile: operational_hygiene remains engineering/control-plane evidence for this owner and has no live article-action receipt path in this validation

methodology_assurance.boundary: Profile declaration, applicability evidence, receipt emission and owner CI are still not independent action-level operational proof. Owner-generated receipts are deliberately marked UNVERIFIED_OWNER_RECEIPT and Universal must verify their evidence refs before operational methodology PASS. No owner regression or receipt proves prose quality improved; a concrete FINANCE_DEEP quality change still requires a passing candidate-distillation package plus independently verified blind pairwise live evidence. FINANCE_BROAD lacks sufficient corpus coverage for any such claim.
